name: Forearm Stretch
steps: Extend one arm in front of you with the elbow straight, palm facing forward and fingers pointing down.
Use your other hand to ease the fingers toward you until the underside of your forearm feels a gentle stretch.
Hold the stretch steadily while keeping your working shoulder relaxed and elbow straight.
Release gently and switch arms to stretch the opposite forearm.
tips: Pull gently across your fingers and palm without yanking forcefully on the wrist joint.
Keep your elbow straight throughout the hold to stretch the full length of the forearm flexors.
